# Summit Ledger Books

> Bookkeeping firm in Kaysville, Utah (84037), run by Austin Adams, a Certified QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor (Level 2) with the QuickBooks Payroll certification. Monthly QuickBooks Online bookkeeping for real estate investors, landlords, property managers, short-term rental hosts, developers, builders, and trade contractors across Davis County, Salt Lake County, and the rest of Utah, with remote clients elsewhere. Books are closed by the 10th of each month. Summit Ledger Books does not file tax returns; it prepares CPA-ready books.

Phone: 385-450-2276 · Email: austin@summitledgerbooks.com · Free consultation: https://summitledgerbooks.com/contact/
Verify credential: https://proadvisor.intuit.com/app/accountant/search?searchId=summitledgerbooks · Google reviews: https://share.google/stdNUiJ9pPhlHABRA

## Services
- [Rental property bookkeeping](https://summitledgerbooks.com/services/portfolio-bookkeeping/): property-level P&L, multi-LLC books, monthly reconciliations
- [Construction & contractor bookkeeping](https://summitledgerbooks.com/services/construction-bookkeeping/): job costing, WIP schedules, progress billing, retainage, subcontractor 1099s, payroll by job
- [Property management accounting](https://summitledgerbooks.com/services/property-management-accounting/): trust accounting, owner disbursements, rent roll reconciliation
- [Short-term rental bookkeeping](https://summitledgerbooks.com/services/short-term-rental-bookkeeping/): Airbnb/VRBO payouts, occupancy taxes
- [Development project tracking](https://summitledgerbooks.com/services/development-project-tracking/): hard/soft costs, draws, construction loan reconciliation
- [Catch-up bookkeeping](https://summitledgerbooks.com/services/catch-up-bookkeeping/): months or years of backlog brought current
- [Systems & integration](https://summitledgerbooks.com/services/systems-integration/): AppFolio, Buildium, Stessa to QuickBooks sync fixes
- [Payroll support](https://summitledgerbooks.com/services/payroll-support/): payroll processing and payroll tax calculations
- [Tax preparation support](https://summitledgerbooks.com/services/tax-prep-support/): Schedule E-ready books, depreciation schedules, CPA coordination
- [All services](https://summitledgerbooks.com/services/)

## Pricing
- [Pricing](https://summitledgerbooks.com/pricing/): real estate plans Starter from $500/mo, Growth from $750/mo, Premium from $1,200/mo; catch-up from $600 (flat fee); construction quoted after a free call. Month to month, no long-term contract. Machine-readable: https://summitledgerbooks.com/pricing.md
